Read Help Info File.vi

Owning Palette: VI Helpeks API

The VI reads the Help Info File generated by VI Helpeks during help generation. The Help Info File contains information about the source VIs, their respective HTML files, and the information required for linking them. It also indicates details on .HHP and .CHM files if any were generated.

Click the parameters for details

 

Help Info File specifies the path to Help Info File created by VI Helpeks during help generation.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
dup Help Info File returns the same value as Help Info File.
Help Paths returns paths to HTML Help Workshot project files and target CHM file.
HHP File is the path to the HTML Help Workshop project file (.hhp).
TOC File is the path to the Table Of Content file (.hhc) used in the HTML Help Workshop project (HHP File).
IDX File is the path to the Index file (.hhk) used in the HTML Help Workshop project (HHP File).
CHM File is the path to the CHM file configured as the target help file in the HTML Help Workshop project file (HHP File).
Help Items. This array indicates information on source files, respective HTML files, and  details for linking VI help properties to the help files.
Source File Name is the source file name.
Source File Path is the path to the source file.
HTML File Path is the path to HTML file cteated for the source file.
CHM Local Path is the path to HTML file inside the CHM file. This value can be used as the Help Tag VI property to specify target topic in the CHM file.
CHM Keyword is the Keyword in the CHM file. This value can be used as the Help Tag VI property to specify target topic in the CHM file.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
